newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal steady, deposits barely changed.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal steady, deposits barely changed.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal was steady against the dollar and riyal interbank deposit rates were barely changed in moderate trade, dealers in the kingdom said.
They said trade focused on the swaps in a liquid market.
"Liquidity is high in the market. Riyal rates were mainly unchanged," one Riyadh-based dealer said.
One and three-month interbank deposits were quoted at 5-9/16, 7/16 percent. Six months were at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent and one-year funds were at 5-3/4, 5/8 percent.
The spot riyal was flat at 3.7504/06 to the dollar.
